name: The University of Alabama in Huntsville
notes: Scope: all 22 rows of the published 2027-28 nonresident academic matrix; Alabama/Tennessee excluded. Each alternative has a separate row key. Original band endpoints remain available on the linked source; the matcher must consider all qualifying lower thresholds. COA unknown.
review_issues: Confirm the official weighted/unweighted GPA basis.

research.policy_note: Bounded manual public-page review. Robots does not disallow this scholarship path. Only public facts and paraphrases retained; no logos, screenshots or copied page prose. General terms, where not located, remain an owner review item.
